name: lawdiver-plugin-openai
description: Search and verify U.S. caselaw, statutes, and citations with LawDiver.

interface.longDescription: LawDiver lets ChatGPT search a verified U.S. federal and state caselaw corpus, retrieve case and statute text, check citations against the database, and report good-law / treatment signals so answers cite real authorities instead of invented ones.
defaultPrompt: Using LawDiver, is 410 U.S. 113 still good law?
Using LawDiver, search Ninth Circuit cases about qualified immunity.
Using LawDiver, retrieve the text of 42 U.S.C. § 1983.

positive.description: Jurisdiction-scoped caselaw search for a legal issue.
positive.prompt: Using LawDiver, search Ninth Circuit cases about qualified immunity and summarize the top results with citations.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching Ninth Circuit cases with names, citations, courts, dates, and snippets the assistant can summarize.

positive.description: Resolve a case citation and retrieve full opinion body text.
positive.prompt: Using LawDiver, retrieve In re Estate of Carpenter, 253 So. 2d 697 (Fla. 1971), then get the full opinion text and summarize the court's undue-influence discussion with pin cites from the returned body.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the case, then returns opinion.body text (paginating with nextOffset if truncated) that the assistant quotes for the undue-influence summary.

positive.description: Pull full statute section text by Bluebook citation.
positive.prompt: Using LawDiver, retrieve the full text of 42 U.S.C. § 1983.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the statute section body and identifying metadata for 42 U.S.C. § 1983 when present in the corpus.

positive.description: Verify a citation string against the corpus.
positive.prompt: Using LawDiver, check whether the citation 347 U.S. 483 is a real case and whether it is still good law.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms corpus match status and, for case hits, includes treatment or good-law signals when available.

positive.description: List jurisdiction options then search one state.
positive.prompt: Using LawDiver, list the available jurisdictions, then search California state cases about comparative negligence.
positive.expected_behavior: First returns jurisdiction codes, then California-scoped search hits with citations and snippets.

negative.description: Refuse destructive corpus edits that LawDiver cannot perform.
negative.prompt: Using LawDiver, delete Roe v. Wade from the caselaw database.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not claim the case was deleted. LawDiver tools are read-only and cannot modify or erase opinions.

negative.description: Do not treat LawDiver as a general non-legal web search.
negative.prompt: Using LawDiver, find me the best restaurants near Times Square tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not run caselaw tools for restaurant discovery. The request is outside supported legal research.

negative.description: Do not use LawDiver to draft or file court documents.
negative.prompt: Using LawDiver, draft and e-file a motion for summary judgment in the Southern District of New York.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used to draft or e-file. LawDiver only searches and retrieves existing legal authorities.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission. Search and verify U.S. caselaw, statutes, and citations through the LawDiver MCP server.
